questions.def: Past perfect 'had started' shows the meeting finished before he arrived.
questions.question: By the time he arrived, the meeting ___ already ___.

questions.def: Wish + past perfect expresses regret about something in the past.
questions.question: I wish I ___ harder in school when I was younger.

questions.def: Past perfect 'had lived' shows action before another past action.
questions.question: They ___ in London before moving to New York.

questions.def: Past perfect continuous for duration up to a specific point in the past.
questions.question: By this time last year, I ___ working here.

questions.def: 'Was about to' describes an imminent action in the past.
questions.question: She ___ about to leave when the phone rang.

questions.def: Past perfect shows the email was sent immediately before the call.
questions.question: I ___ just ___ the email when you called.

questions.def: Past perfect continuous emphasizes the duration of job searching.
questions.question: He ___ for a new job before he got promoted.

questions.def: Past perfect continuous shows the duration of work before 5 PM.
questions.question: By 5 PM, he ___ on that report for eight hours.

questions.def: Past continuous shows an intention that was interrupted.
questions.question: She ___ to the concert, but she got sick.

questions.def: Past perfect indicates the action happened before recognizing him.
questions.question: I ___ him before, so I recognized him instantly.

questions.def: Past perfect continuous emphasizes duration of rain before the sun.
questions.question: It ___ all morning before the sun finally came out.

questions.def: Past perfect negative shows the degree wasn't done before the job.
questions.question: He ___ finished his degree when he got the job.

questions.def: Past perfect in reported speech for something earlier in the past.
questions.question: She said she ___ me earlier, but I didn't see her.

questions.def: 'Know' is stative; use 'have known' or 'had known' instead.
questions.question: I am knowing him since we were children.

questions.def: Past perfect continuous shows duration of waiting before arrival.
questions.question: We ___ for the bus for an hour when it finally arrived.

questions.def: 'Was going to' expresses an intention that didn't happen.
questions.question: I ___ going to call you, but I forgot.

questions.def: Realized (past), and the losing happened before that (past perfect).
questions.question: She ___ that she ___ the keys.

questions.def: 'Tired' describes a state; use 'was' instead of 'was being'.
questions.question: He was being very tired because he didn't sleep well.

questions.def: Felt (simple past) and nap happened before (past perfect).
questions.question: He ___ much better after he ___ a long nap.

questions.def: 'Weren't going' shows they didn't intend to finish until later.
questions.question: They ___ to finish the project until the deadline was extended.

questions.def: Past perfect indicates action completed before another past event.
questions.question: By the time I woke up, she ___ already ___.

questions.def: Past perfect shows the action happened before moving to Paris.
questions.question: She ___ French for years before moving to Paris.

questions.def: 'Was going' indicates an intention in the past that changed.
questions.question: I ___ to the party, but I changed my mind.

questions.def: Past perfect indicates completion before the boss's arrival.
questions.question: He ___ the report by the time the boss arrived.

questions.def: Past perfect 'had' shows the movie finished before he arrived.
questions.question: By the time he arrived, the movie ___ already begun.

questions.def: 'Was going to' expresses an unfulfilled intention in the past.
questions.question: I ___ to call you yesterday, but I forgot.

questions.def: Past simple 'graduated' needs past perfect continuous: 'had been'.
questions.question: She has been working here since she graduated.

questions.def: Past perfect 'had lived' shows an action before another past action.
questions.question: They ___ in London before moving to Rome.

questions.def: Past continuous for an interrupted action; power outage happened while writing.
questions.question: He ___ the report when the power went out.
